status: Protocol fixed before this push extracts NFL turn responses; not a fresh blind test because the program previously inspected WR 2025 outcomes.
primary_question: Does route-matched Combine execution beyond approach speed and turn demand predict NFL half-second post-turn speed deficit?
turn_definition: First local peak of heading change over +/-0.3 s, peaks at least 1.0 s apart; turn angle 25–150 degrees; mean entry speed over -0.5 to -0.3 s >=2.5 yd/s; endpoint position-derived speeds >=1 yd/s. No global largest-turn selection.
nfl_eligibility: Rookie REG non-nullified mapped routes; unique ball_snap and pass_forward; continuous 10 Hz snap-to-release frames; first eligible turn 0.5–3.0 s after snap; minimum ten fully measured half-second turn windows per player.
primary_response: Integral from turn to +0.5 s of max(0,1-speed/entry_speed) dt, in seconds of normalized post-turn deficit. Six observed speed samples required. No imputed unobserved recovery.
recovery_secondary: First two consecutive samples >=90% entry speed after local speed minimum; follow until release or 1.5 s after turn. Right-censored records retained. Distribution-free recovery bounds report unresolved outcomes, without independent-censoring assumptions.
source_adjustment: Training players only: source response ridge alpha10 versus entry speed, angle, entry*angle, entry squared and angle squared. Aggregate residuals by player/mapped route, then residualize against conventional physical attributes. Four execution traits plus fixed quadratic and game-demand/mass interactions.
primary_contrast: execution versus source_demands; controls route-matched source entry speed, angle, impulse and accepted-attempt count
secondary_targets: receiver separation at pass release on measured subset
candidate_budget: Same five conventional ridge/forest/extra-tree configurations per family; no 2025 selection
validation: Four unique-player class-stratified outer / three inner folds on 2023+2024; 2023 train / 2024 tune / refit earlier classes / 2025 exploratory transport; two additional earlier-player partitions if population passes feasibility
feasibility: At least ten eligible players in each of 2023,2024,2025 for season transport; otherwise report failure and do not silently relax this protocol.
negative_controls: Whole-player source-profile swaps within training class, with fixed selected configurations; retain unfavorable results. Do not call these formal permutation p-values.
interpretation: NFL turn demand is measured outcome-side context. This is conditional mechanical transfer, not a deployable live prediction or a causal player-development effect. Separation selection and censored recovery are reported.
